 PSU Vikings prep for final two games in first season under new head coach 
 The Portland State Vikings football team is preparing for their final two games of their first season under head coach Chris Fisk. By Mariah Ross Published : Nov. 12, 2026 at 8:16 PM PST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google PORTLAND Ore. (KPTV) - The Portland State Vikings football team is preparing for their final two games of their first season under head coach Chris Fisk.
 FOX 12 spoke with Coach Fisk about what this season has meant for the team.
